fixes_applied.note: Resolved pre-merge conflict: merged HEAD registrations (ActionItemAnalyticsService, VotingBehaviourService, AnalyticsController, VotingBehaviourController, LiveDecisionService, LiveMeetingController, ALVMinutesService, ActionItemExtractionService, DecisionNotificationService, MinutesService, ProjectionController) with origin/development registrations (OriPublicationService, MotionService, VotingService, MotionController, VotingController)
Fixed AnalyticsController DI registration to include missing userSession and groupManager constructor parameters (PHPStan caught: 'Missing parameter $groupManager / $userSession')
Resolved both-sides-add merge conflict by combining all DI registrations from HEAD (analytics, projection, ALV, live-decision stack) and origin/development (motion, voting, ORI stack)

AnalyticsController DI registration was missing IUserSession and IGroupManager constructor args — added both, matching the LiveMeetingController pattern in the same file. Without this fix the controller's admin guard (isAdmin()) would never execute — a TypeError at construction time would short-circuit to HTTP 500 before any auth check ran.
